summary.title: Introduction | discord.js Guide
summary.one_liner: This guide teaches you how to build a Discord bot with discord.js, starting from JavaScript prerequisites and covering commands, components, databases, and sharding.
takeaways: Know the JavaScript basics needed before building a discord.js bot; the guide links free resources such as Eloquent JavaScript and MDN for this.
The guide covers creating, organizing, and expanding bot commands.
It includes in-depth topics like components, reactions, embeds, and canvas.
It covers working with databases such as sequelize and keyv, and getting started with sharding.
It also addresses common errors, keeping code clean, and setting up a development environment.
summary.summary: This is the introductory page of the discord.js guide, a tutorial for building Discord bots with the discord.js library. It explains that readers should have a reasonable grasp of JavaScript first and lists free learning resources for it. It then previews the rest of the guide, which covers bot setup, command structure, components, reactions, embeds, canvas, databases (sequelize and keyv), sharding, common errors, and development environment setup.
